column4: A license banner whose line 1 is "/" plus only asterisks opens a doc comment; doclint reports dc.unexpected.comment before package and -Werror fails the JDK build. Change only the opener "/**" to "/* " (same length) where line 2 is a Synexia copyright line, and fix the generators that emit the banner (ARRAY_MAP.java.tmpl, stale-contracts apply.py HEADER) in the same commit.
